name: The Mossel Defense
description: Soviet forces have broken Allied defenses and approach the Mossel River in successive waves.
objective: Survive and destroy every attacking Soviet vehicle.

name: Siegen Infiltration
description: Supply convoys from Essen have disappeared near hilly Siegen. Intelligence suggests one or possibly two Soviet bases; Hind sightings remain unconfirmed in the briefing.
objective: Find and destroy the Soviet base or bases.

name: Nuremberg Highway
description: An Allied base has lost resupply; two convoys failed to arrive. Intelligence reports heavy ATGW activity in roadside hills.
objective: Clear all Soviet forces along the highway and reopen the supply route.

name: Mass Destruction
description: Soviet troops approach from north and west, threatening the M1 base near the Emes River.
objective: Destroy all three nearby enemy bases.

name: The Road to Bonn
description: After Frankfurt falls, Soviet armor moves toward Bonn. The Mainz bridge offers passage across the Rhine around Allied forces at Koblenz.

name: Hannover Push
description: Soviet forces have overrun Hannover and amassed weapons and vehicles for an attack toward Cologne. A communications fort lies east of their base.

name: Convoy
description: Soviet attacks threaten civilian relief supplies moving through Siegen toward Weller.
objective: Escort and protect the five-truck convoy until it reaches Allied Base Weller across the Rhine.

name: The Mossel Intercept
description: Damaged Allied vehicles lie west of the player, across the Mossel, after defeating a Soviet reconnaissance group. A powerful Soviet patrol approaches southward along the river.
objective: Reach the damaged Allied vehicles before the Soviet patrol, then escort them to your base.
